baseline_prompt_en: A natural street photograph of a fictional adult model wearing a modern cropped denim jacket and straight-leg trousers, standing beside a bicycle outside a neighborhood café on an overcast morning. Use a relaxed three-quarter-length portrait with the jacket clearly readable. One hand rests on the bicycle handlebar; the elbow bends comfortably, and the bicycle stands alongside the model on its kickstand. The jacket's cropped hem and everyday denim construction remain visible above the trouser waist. The model pauses with a slight easy smile, their free arm hanging loosely as they glance toward the café entrance. Diffuse morning light picks up the jacket's fabric grain and the smooth worn handlebar grip. A softly reflected café window and a small damp patch below the bicycle wheel give the setting the feel of an ordinary arrival. The visible hand, handlebar and jacket form a connected foreground, while the café recedes gently. Natural skin and fabric texture, an informal posture and the quiet street light make the person's everyday ease the photograph's subtle appeal.
